note: Original 219 from prior tc:web log. 66 closed by tsconfig ghostty-vt include, ghostty-surface-api add, and earlier duck-type widening. Remaining 153 classified below. Each original diagnostic maps to exactly one bucket.

buckets.representative: File src/ghostty-vt/*.ts is not listed within tsconfig.tc.web.json include
buckets.rootCause: Ghostty sources were added to the worktree but not included in the web typecheck project; ghostty-surface-api was not copied into the generated tree.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: tsconfig include + overlay add of Horca-owned files

buckets.representative: Types of property 'linkHandler.leave' are incompatible: (event, text) => void vs () => void / (...args: never[]) => void
buckets.rootCause: Production helpers were retargeted from @xterm/xterm Terminal to a surface duck type whose linkHandler.leave arity does not match xterm or Ghostty. Tests still construct @xterm/xterm Terminal.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Align surface ITerminalOptions.linkHandler with xterm ILinkHandler (leave(event, uri)). Do not widen PaneTerminal.

buckets.representative: ITerminalOptions is not assignable to Partial<OrcaPaneAppearance> (linkHandler.activate optional vs required)
buckets.rootCause: Ghostty constructor takes OrcaPaneAppearance; callers pass ITerminalOptions / optional activate.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: OrcaPaneAppearance.linkHandler matches ITerminalOptions; pane-dom-creation only sets activate when present

buckets.representative: Cannot invoke attachCustomKeyEventHandler / scrollToTop / loadAddon / registerCharacterJoiner; modes possibly undefined
buckets.rootCause: Surface Terminal marked methods optional that both xterm Terminal and OrcaPaneTerminal implement. Callers invoke them as required.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Require methods that both implementations provide. Guard xterm-only methods (loadAddon, joiners) at the helper.

buckets.representative: Argument of type surface Terminal is not assignable to XtermTerminalWithUnicodeCore
buckets.rootCause: Unicode width shim is an xterm core hook. Ghostty owns Unicode in WASM.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Call activateOrcaTerminalUnicodeProvider only when terminal.unicode is the xterm IUnicodeHandling object

buckets.representative: PaneTerminal has no properties in common with ArabicShapingTerminal
buckets.rootCause: RTL joiners are an xterm DOM/WebGL workaround. Ghostty shapes in WASM. Helper typed as weak Pick of xterm-only methods.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Helper accepts object and no-ops when registerCharacterJoiner is absent. Do not add joiners to PaneTerminal.

buckets.representative: Property 'onBufferChange' does not exist on type '{ active: OrcaTerminalGrid }'
buckets.rootCause: Split-scroll waited on xterm Buffer.onBufferChange for alt-screen exit.

buckets.representative: Property 'onWriteParsed' does not exist on type 'Terminal'
buckets.rootCause: Helper already no-ops if onWriteParsed is missing, but the duck type omitted the optional method. Ghostty hub implements onWriteParsed via onData.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Add optional onWriteParsed to the surface duck type only

buckets.representative: Property 'getSelectionPosition' does not exist on type 'Terminal'
buckets.rootCause: Caller reads selection range for a size cap. Method is not on PaneTerminal. OrcaPaneTerminal already implements it.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Optional getSelectionPosition on the surface duck type; helper uses optional call. Do not add to PaneTerminal.

buckets.representative: Property 'buildNumber' does not exist on type '{}'
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Type windowsPty as { backend?: string; buildNumber?: number }

buckets.rootCause: Optional registerMarker return type is a thin disposable; ScrollState expects xterm IMarker.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Only store a marker when isDisposed and line exist; otherwise restore via viewportY

buckets.representative: Type '"alternate" | "normal" | undefined' is not assignable to '"alternate" | "normal"'
buckets.rootCause: Grid type was optional. Ghostty buffer already sets it.

buckets.representative: modes.showCursor is boolean | undefined, helper wants boolean
buckets.rootCause: Helper required showCursor: boolean after surface modes made it optional
OrcaLink.text optional; sort comparator reads it

buckets.representative: PREVIEW_COLS / PREVIEW_ROWS declared but never used
buckets.rootCause: Ghostty sizes from measureRoot; cols/rows args dropped
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Resize Ghostty to PREVIEW_COLS x PREVIEW_ROWS after mount

buckets.representative: proposeDimensions() returns null | undefined; caller wants undefined
buckets.rootCause: D0 already returns null. Callers not updated.
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Call site: proposeDimensions() ?? undefined. Do not change PaneTerminal.

buckets.representative: OrcaLink[] is not assignable to ILink[] because text is optional
buckets.rootCause: ILink aliased to OrcaLink with optional text; tests use xterm ILink with required text
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Keep text optional; tests pass OrcaLink. Or provide text: string on fixtures.

buckets.representative: Assorted test-only mismatches closed by earlier duck-type and Ghostty include work
buckets.rootCause: Tests compiled by tc:web against the surface duck type / missing Ghostty files
buckets.intendedFixLocation: Closed with buckets A and B-related duck-type work before this checkpoint

buckets.representative: Earlier unclassified production errors closed before this checkpoint (Ghostty assignability, tsconfig)
